newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to grant new mobile phone licence end 97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to grant new mobile phone licence end 97.

text.p: The Portuguese government will grant a licence to a third mobile telephone operator by the end of 1997 or the beginning of 1998 at the very latest, a government official said.

"We'll open the competition for the licence by the end of June and grant it by the end of the year or at the start of 1998," said Maria Augusta Goncalves, spokeswoman for the Secretary of State for Housing and Communications.
At present only two companies hold licences for the Portuguese mobile phone market, TMN-Telecomunicacoes Moveis Nacionais, owned by Portugal Telecom, and Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais.
Goncalves said that all three operators would be able to use new digital DCS 1800 technology.
"There are free frequencies which will also be made available to the two existing operators so as not to distort competition," she said.
